Front legs split into shoulder->knee->foot; hind legs split into hip-joint->stifle->foot, inferred anatomical joints since only shoulder/hip and ground contacts are directly visible on the grid. Left/right leg lateral (z) offsets inferred from ZY panel spacing (~2 units each side of centerline) since XY panel cannot show depth. All leg chains parent to spine nodes (withers for front, hip for rear) independently for L and R, never sharing a joint below the spine.
